title: Dashboard
subtitle: Your job-search HQ: vacancy progress, upcoming steps, and quick access to everything.

gettingStarted.heading: 👋 Getting started
gettingStarted.step1: Add a few vacancies or import them on the "Vacancies" tab.
gettingStarted.step2: Click "Analyze all" — the app will detect each vacancy's stack itself.
gettingStarted.step3: Check the "Roadmap" and "Skill radar" — they'll show what to pick up for the market.

focusWeek.heading: 🎯 Focus of the week
focusWeek.empty: Add a few vacancies — and personalized priorities for the week will show up here.
focusWeek.offline: Basic tips (AI offline). Set a key in server/.env for personalized analysis.

upcomingSteps.heading: 📅 Upcoming steps
upcomingSteps.empty: Nothing scheduled — add a "next step" date on your vacancies.

notifications.enabledToast: Reminders enabled — we'll check for overdue steps next time you open the app
